title: Pangram check
statement_markdown: Determine if a sentence is a pangram. A pangram is a sentence using every letter of the alphabet at least once. The check should be case-insensitive, and you should ignore any non-alphabetic characters.

examples.input: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"

hints: Convert the string to lowercase first.
Use a `set` to collect all the unique alphabetic characters.
Check if the size of the set is 26.
explanation: We convert the sentence to lowercase, iterate through it, and add every alphabetic character to a set. If the set's length becomes 26, it is a pangram.
complexity: O(N) time and O(1) space, where N is the length of the string.
